text:
```artifact
TC-001: [VCMCL03-1] Edit existing Chemist/Lab
  Steps: 
    1. Navigate to Edit/Update Chemist/Labs screen
    2. Enter valid Chemist/Lab Id and click 'Search'
    3. Verify Chemist/Lab details (Name, Address, Contact) are displayed
    4. Modify Address field
    5. Click 'Save'
    6. Verify update success

TC-002: [VCMCL03-2] Edit non-existent Chemist/Lab
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Edit/Update Chemist/Labs screen
    2. Enter non-existent Chemist/Lab Id and click 'Search'
    3. Verify error message "Chemist or Lab does not exist" is displayed

TC-003: [VCMCL03-3] Delete Chemist/Lab with open prescriptions
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Delete Chemist/Lab screen
    2. Enter Chemist/Lab Id with open prescriptions and click 'Delete'
    3. Verify error message "Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete" is displayed

TC-004: [VCMSYM02] Add Symptom Code
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Add Symptom Code screen
    2. Enter Symptom Code and Symptom Description
    3. Click 'Save'
    4. Verify symptom is added successfully

TC-005: [VCMSYM03] Edit existing Symptom
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Edit/Update Symptom screen
    2. Enter existing Symptom Code and click 'Search'
    3. Verify Symptom Description is displayed
    4. Modify Symptom Description
    5. Click 'Save'
    6. Verify update success

TC-006: [VCMSYM03] Edit non-existent Symptom
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Edit/Update Symptom screen
    2. Enter non-existent Symptom Code and click 'Search'
    3. Verify error message "Symptom does not exist" is displayed

TC-007: [VCMPA01] Update Patient Profile
  Steps:
    1. Navigate to Patient Profile Update screen
    2. Modify Address field
    3. Click 'Save'
    4. Verify update success and ability to raise consultation

TC-008: [VCDPA02] Register new Patient
  Steps:
    1. Enter Patient details (Name, Age, Sex, Address, Contact)
    2. Click 'Register'
    3. Verify Patient Id is generated and details captured
```
